comment: Independent C-first natural monster-entry witness for trap.c:fire_damage_chain through apply.c:do_break_wand -> dig.c:liquid_flow -> mon.c:minliquid_core. A debug Barbarian enables Levitation and invulnerability, moves to a clear square, creates a peaceful fire giant with source-generated inventory, wishes a digging wand and lava underfoot, then breaks the wand. The blast angers but does not kill the fire-resistant giant; surrounding lava fills its square, liquid_flow calls minliquid, and the surviving giant burns slightly before relocation. The final spaces acknowledge C-observed More pages through that callback.
